title: Meridian: Borrowed Dawn
description: An original superhero thriller about a city-wide power seizure, costly choices, and multiple ways to resist.

defaultCharacter.name: Rook
defaultCharacter.description: A field medic who shapes amber light into tools and shields.

powers.name: Amber Implement
powers.description: Solid light forms a lever, brace, or cable. It grants creation and telekinesis capabilities and helps force or rescue checks for two turns.

powers.name: Pattern Sight
powers.description: Read small movements and mechanical patterns. Adds two to perception or investigation checks.

powers.name: Field Mending
powers.description: A pulse of amber light closes wounds, restoring five health. It cannot reverse death or undo an ending.

powers.name: Amber Guard
powers.description: A temporary light barrier absorbs the next six incoming damage.

powers.name: Amber Bolt
powers.description: A precision light lance inflicts six fixed damage on an active enemy if its attack succeeds.

arrival.title: The city that signed itself away
arrival.text:
At 18:00, every public screen in Meridian turns white. Administrator Vey appears wearing the city's emergency seal. “For your protection, all unlicensed abilities will be suspended.” Across the plaza, a baker loses the floating hands that held her ovens shut. The doors burst open. A courier falls out of the air.

In the tower above you, the Concordance Engine is taking more than powers. Its first test erased a volunteer's memories of resisting. Tonight it will overwrite everyone connected to the city's emergency network.

You are Rook, a field medic who makes solid amber light. Engineer Imani Vale has asked you to reach the tower before its final transmission. She is already inside. You can approach through the crowded clinic, the freight tunnels, or the roof. Your character's identity and abilities may differ if you created or imported one; the mission belongs to whoever you bring.

This adventure permits genuine defeat. A failed check changes your route or costs fixed health; it is not an invitation to press the same button until it works. Ordinary skills can solve every mandatory obstacle. Powers help through their actual effects, not through their names.

You have 38 actions before the final transmission. A power used on its own consumes an action; pairing a power with a check consumes one action total. Any rest also advances the countdown. Spend preparation deliberately.

Your five starting powers demonstrate tools, insight, healing, shields, and direct attacks. You can instead create a wholly different character before play. Custom power descriptions are flavor; their selected effects and supported capability tags determine what actually changes.

actions.label: Help the plaza clinic and approach with the rescue crews

success.text: You take the street route. People remember who stops to help.

actions.label: Slip into the tower’s freight tunnels

success.text: A service stair descends beneath the propaganda screens.

actions.label: Climb the adjacent greenhouse and cross to the roof

success.text: The greenhouse ribs offer a route above the checkpoints.

clinic.title: Hands in the machinery
clinic.text:
A delivery crane has folded across the clinic entrance. Its operator is conscious beneath the cab; the power that normally lightens its load is gone. A nurse named Tamsin holds pressure on a patient's wound and points you toward a manual release.

Helping here will give you a witness inside the rescue crews. Going around is safe, but the clinic cannot vouch for you later.

actions.label: Use a wrecking bar to shift the crane

success.text: The lever bends, but the crane moves. Tamsin gives you a responder’s band.

failure.text: The crane shifts onto your shoulder. You free the operator, but take a hard blow. Tamsin still gives you the band.

actions.label: Trace and disengage the manual brake

success.text: You isolate the loaded cable and lower it safely. Tamsin gives you a responder’s band.

failure.text: The brake releases too early. You drag the operator clear of flying debris.

actions.label: Leave the rescue to the arriving crew and find another entrance

success.text: The crew has enough hands now, but no one has time to clear you through security.

rescue_gate.title: A guard with an actual choice
rescue_gate.text:
Officer Bren stands at the tower's emergency door. He has orders to turn rescuers away. Through the glass behind him, you can see people locked into diagnostic chairs. Several are conscious and trying to undo their restraints.

Bren sees your responder band. “Tell me this isn't another armed takeover.” He sounds frightened, not loyal.

actions.label: Ask Bren to protect the patients instead of the order

success.text: Bren unlocks the door and quietly gives you his override token. “Bring them out.”

failure.text: Bren cannot make himself disobey in front of his camera. He leaves a maintenance hatch unlatched instead.

actions.label: Read the patrol rhythm and walk through with a stretcher

success.text: You time the shift change and enter behind the stretcher.

failure.text: A scanner catches the borrowed route. You duck a stun bolt and escape into a service hatch.

actions.label: Pull the emergency door off its compromised frame

success.text: The hinges tear. Bren steps aside rather than fire into the clinic.

failure.text: The frame holds long enough for a stun burst to hit you. You retreat through the maintenance hatch.

freight.title: The conveyor under Meridian
freight.text: The freight tunnel carries empty medical crates toward a locked loading dock. A wall map shows two possible exits: a low inspection channel beneath the belt, or a cage lift controlled by a scorched panel. The tunnel is unpleasant, but no superhuman ability is required to cross it.

actions.label: Crawl through the inspection channel

success.text: You emerge beside the loading console before its camera sweeps back.

failure.text: The belt catches your coat. You tear free with bruised ribs and stumble into the maintenance bay.

actions.label: Repair the cage-lift contacts

success.text: A scavenged fuse brings the lift to life. You ride to the loading dock.

failure.text: The panel spits sparks. A side hatch gets you out, but the overload burns your hand.

actions.label: Brace the service gate open and squeeze through

success.text: You hold the gate through one grinding cycle and reach the dock.

failure.text: The gate clips your side. You force yourself clear into the maintenance bay.

greenhouse.title: Across the glass ribs
greenhouse.text:
A greenhouse bridges the next building's upper floors. Below its glass roof, ordinary tomato vines survive in a city that celebrates miraculous inventions. A gap separates the final rib from the tower's cooling platform.

You can move carefully, rig a cable, or carry a heavy plank across. The route changes the difficulty, not whether the story considers your character important.

actions.label: Cross on the narrow support rib

success.text: You land on the cooling platform without waking its sensors.

failure.text: The rib breaks. You catch a drainage ladder, strike the wall, and crawl into a service bay below.

actions.label: Rig a safety line from the greenhouse winch

success.text: The line holds and becomes an evacuation route for later.

failure.text: The winch jams. You descend by a safe ladder instead, losing your route advantage.

actions.label: Lift a maintenance plank into a temporary bridge

success.text: You bridge the gap and cross with the plank behind you.

failure.text: The plank twists and strikes your chest. You recover on a lower ladder.

loading.title: Cargo that can answer back
loading.text:
A sealed crate thumps from inside. It holds Orin, the tower's former records clerk, whose ability to remember documents made him a security risk. He has no weapon, but he knows where Vey's signed trial orders are stored.

The dock lift is about to rise. You have one chance to open the restraint clamp before the crate leaves this floor.

actions.label: Pick the transport clamp

success.text: Orin unfolds from the crate and memorizes your face. He points you to the archive.

failure.text: The clamp snaps on your fingers. You pry the crate lid open enough for Orin to breathe, but the lift carries him upward.

actions.label: Break the restraint bracket

success.text: The bracket gives. Orin is free and tells you where the evidence is.

failure.text: The reinforced bracket rings like a bell. A security drone grazes you before you flee.

actions.label: Jam the lift relay while you release him

success.text: The lift stalls just long enough. Orin slips free and shares his archive knowledge.

failure.text: The relay locks in its last command. The lift rises, but you reach the atrium unhurt.

rooftop.title: The false emergency broadcast
rooftop.text:
The cooling platform houses a relay that will carry Vey's commands across the city. A technician in a grey vest watches a diagnostic screen. She believes the Engine is a temporary response to a reactor accident.

You can convince her, quietly reroute the signal, or break its mounting. Disabling this relay gives the ending a different shape: the tower may fall without taking the city's entire network with it.

actions.label: Show the technician what is happening in the plaza

success.text: She checks her own camera feed, pales, and helps isolate the relay.

failure.text: She calls security, then hesitates when she sees the feed. You leave before the guards arrive.

actions.label: Route the relay into its internal test loop

success.text: The relay continues reporting success while broadcasting only to itself.

failure.text: A surge runs through your tool. The relay remains live.

actions.label: Tear out the relay’s physical coupler

success.text: The coupler breaks cleanly. The wider network is isolated.

failure.text: The relay’s casing throws you back. You retreat into the access stair.

maintenance.title: The price of the shortcut
maintenance.text:
You reach a maintenance bay smelling of hot insulation. Imani calls through a cracked intercom: “The Engine isn't a person. It follows rules. Vey is the one who keeps choosing what those rules do.”

There is a field dressing on the wall and a charged service battery under the bench. Taking either is a deliberate preparation choice. The lift into the atrium is open; you cannot safely return to this bay after it rises.

actions.label: Use the field dressing before going up

success.text: The dressing stops the bleeding. You take the lift.

actions.label: Take the battery’s charge into your equipment or power reserve

success.text: You recover a little energy and head up.

actions.label: Study the service map instead

success.text: You memorize a direct access route to the archive.

atrium.title: Three floors, three promises
atrium.text:
The tower's atrium surrounds an empty monument to civic trust. Above it, a column of white light climbs toward the transmitter. Imani is holding a manual circuit open from the control floor; she cannot leave without accelerating the final overwrite.

You can reach the patient ward, the records archive, or the lens chamber before the final ascent. These are real priorities, not interchangeable descriptions. The ward can save captives. The archive can prove who ordered this. The lens can weaken the Engine. After completing one, you will have a choice to attempt one additional objective or go straight to Imani.

actions.label: Go to the patient ward

success.text: You follow the sound of people calling each other’s names.

actions.label: Go to the records archive

success.text: You climb toward the floor where the trial orders were stored.

actions.label: Go to the lens chamber

success.text: You follow the beam to the mechanism feeding it.

ward.title: Names instead of numbers
ward.text:
The ward holds a dozen people in diagnostic chairs. Their monitor labels are changing from names into serial numbers. A frightened orderly named Eda still has the physical release key, but the Engine has locked the door controls.

No one here needs you to demonstrate a magnificent power. They need the restraints opened and a way out.

actions.label: Keep Eda calm while she works through the releases

success.text: Eda trusts you, remembers the sequence, and frees the ward.

failure.text: Eda freezes at the alarm. You free the nearest two people, but security seals the remaining chairs.

actions.label: Identify the correct manual release sequence

success.text: You notice each chair’s release follows its heartbeat monitor. The patients are freed.

failure.text: The sequence triggers a security pulse. You free two patients before it locks.

actions.label: Break the common restraint rail

success.text: The rail tears loose and all twelve patients can move.

failure.text: The rail snaps back across your arm. You free only the two nearest chairs before the remaining locks harden.

archive.title: The signature at the bottom
archive.text:
The archive is deleting itself one cabinet at a time. A paper copy of the first trial order survives in a locked fireproof drawer. Vey signed a permanent transfer of captured abilities to the Concordance Engine, not a temporary safety measure.

Recovering proof matters even if the city never sees it tonight. Without proof, Vey can still call this a misunderstanding.

actions.label: Follow the memorized service map to the protected drawer

success.text: Your earlier preparation pays off. You recover the signed order.

failure.text: The drawer is already sealing. You recover only an incomplete transfer list.

actions.label: Use the service records to locate the original drawer

success.text: You recover the signed order and a list of unwilling subjects.

failure.text: The index is already erased. You escape the purge with an incomplete copy showing only the transfer totals.

actions.label: Recognize which cabinet was used most recently

success.text: A fresh scrape under one drawer leads you to the signed original.

failure.text: The cabinet seals around a false trail. A suppression burst catches your shoulder.

actions.label: Pull the fireproof drawer out of the wall

success.text: The drawer comes free with the documents inside.

failure.text: You crack the shell, but heat destroys the signature before you can reach it.

lens.title: A machine with too much to eat
lens.text:
The lens chamber is full of suspended fragments of stolen abilities. A hundred little miracles orbit a core that is swallowing them. Its access sockets are ordinary hardware beneath all the spectacle.

A handwritten maintenance instruction warns that a clean bypass will let the stored abilities return to their owners. Breaking the lens stops it, but some stolen abilities may be lost.

actions.label: Build the documented bypass circuit

success.text: The bypass comes alive. The stored abilities can return when the Engine stops.

failure.text: The bypass overloads. You pull away before it consumes your equipment.

actions.label: Follow the energy rhythm and isolate the feed

success.text: You shut the feed between pulses. The stolen abilities remain recoverable.

failure.text: The pulse hits before the isolator closes. You stagger out.

actions.label: Shatter the lens mounting with a maintenance hammer

success.text: The lens breaks. The Engine loses its reserve, but several fragments wink out.

failure.text: The mounting survives and flings the hammer back into you.

crossroads.title: One more detour
crossroads.text:
The beam above you has narrowed into a single hard line. Imani says the final door is beginning to close. You can make one more detour to a floor you haven't visited, but every extra encounter risks your remaining health and energy. Or you can reach her now.

You cannot do everything. Decide what must survive this night.

actions.label: Attempt the patient ward before the ascent

success.text: You take the last available detour.

actions.label: Attempt the archive before the ascent

success.text: You take the last available detour.

actions.label: Attempt the lens chamber before the ascent

success.text: You take the last available detour.

actions.label: Go directly to Imani

success.text: You turn toward the control floor.

ascent.title: The last staircase
ascent.text:
The stairwell above you is blocked by a fallen security shutter. On the other side, Imani is counting the seconds between surges. You hear another voice: Vey ordering her to let go.

There is a crawlspace beside the shutter, a mechanical ratchet in its frame, and a direct climb up the outside of the stair rail. The next check can hurt you, but it will not invent a requirement for a power you do not have.

actions.label: Work the shutter’s ratchet by hand

success.text: The shutter rises far enough. You reach Imani.

failure.text: You force it open at the cost of a crushed shoulder.

actions.label: Navigate the tight service crawlspace

success.text: You slip out beside the control dais.

failure.text: A hot cable burns your back as you force through.

actions.label: Use Bren’s override token

success.text: The token opens a narrow emergency corridor. A choice downstairs has spared you this fight.

actions.label: Use the escape line you prepared on the roof

success.text: The line lets you skirt the shutter on the outside and climb directly to Imani.

control.title: The person holding the switch
control.text:
Imani is braced against a red manual lever. Blood runs from her palm. Vey stands behind a transparent barrier, a city administrator in an immaculate coat rather than a monster in armor.

“Every catastrophe here began with somebody exceptional,” Vey says. “I can make an ordinary city. A safe one.”

“You can make obedient people,” Imani replies. “That isn't the same promise.”

A security sentinel powers up between you and the lever. Its shield cycles visibly: three seconds bright, one second dark. You can fight it, redirect it, or convince its human operator to stand down.

actions.label: Engage the sentinel during its dark shield cycle

success.text: You strike during the gap and break its targeting arm.

failure.text: Your strike hits the bright shield. The sentinel lands a fixed four-damage blow.

actions.label: Feed a maintenance target into the sentinel’s sensor

success.text: It turns toward the empty maintenance gantry. You have a path to the lever.

failure.text: Vey cancels the false target. The sentinel clips you with its arm.

actions.label: Ask the operator whether the people in those chairs consented

success.text: The operator sees the ward feed and cuts the sentinel’s command link.

failure.text: The operator hesitates, but Vey takes direct control.

actions.label: Have Bren order the operator to stand down

success.text: A colleague’s voice breaks the operator’s certainty. The sentinel powers down.

failure.text: Vey seizes direct control before the operator can respond.

sentinel_breached.title: One opening is not a victory
sentinel_breached.text:
The sentinel's arm hangs loose. Its shield is still cycling, but now each dark interval lasts long enough to exploit. Imani needs only a moment for you to reach the cutoff.

You can finish the machine, pin it beneath the gantry, or pass it while it recovers. Any attack damage in this adventure is fixed; only the success of the maneuver is rolled.

The sentinel has 12 health, a +2 attack modifier, and deals 3 fixed damage if it hits. Each committed action gives it a response while it remains active. It stops attacking when defeated. Your ordinary attacks and any offensive custom powers use the same real health pool.

actions.label: Strike its exposed power joint (5 fixed damage)

success.text: You land a heavy blow for five damage.

failure.text: The joint twists away from your strike.

actions.label: Strike a vulnerable cable (4 fixed damage)

success.text: Your precise strike cuts a cable for four damage.

failure.text: The cable pulls out of reach.

actions.label: Jam the gantry into its mechanism (5 fixed damage)

success.text: The gantry grinds against the sentinel for five damage.

failure.text: The release catches before the gantry can reach it.

actions.label: Risk dodging past it without defeating it

success.text: You pass its damaged side and reach the lever, though it gets one final swing.

failure.text: It forces you back against the wall.

actions.label: Step past the defeated sentinel

success.text: The machine is down. You reach Imani and the cutoff.

sentinel_pressure.title: No room for another mistake
sentinel_pressure.text:
The sentinel drives you against the wall. Vey has overridden its safety limits. The floor is cracking under its feet; those cracks expose the same mundane service conduits you saw below.

You can still win, but the cost of a failed desperate attempt is larger now. Retreat is a real option and a real loss for the city, not a secret victory.

actions.label: Rupture its exposed coolant conduit

success.text: Coolant blinds its sensors. You slip past as it freezes in place.

failure.text: The conduit is reinforced. Its return strike deals six damage; if you survive, you are forced back out of the tower.

actions.label: Draw it onto the cracked floor and dodge

success.text: The floor gives beneath the sentinel. It falls one story, and you reach the lever.

failure.text: You move a fraction too late. The impact deals five damage and knocks you into the emergency stair.

actions.label: Find and sever its direct-control wire

success.text: You spot the pulsing cable and wrench it free. The sentinel folds into standby.

failure.text: The cable was a decoy. A restraint field throws you down and Vey completes the sequence.

actions.label: Retreat while you can still carry the warning outside

success.text: You leave with what you managed to save. Behind you, the white beam reaches the transmitter.

final_choice.title: What you choose to save
final_choice.text:
You reach Imani. Together you can stop the final transmission, but the tower is failing. The cutoff offers three outcomes, not one perfect button.

A controlled shutdown can return powers if you prepared the lens. A public broadcast can expose Vey if you recovered the signed orders. An emergency destruction route will stop the Engine regardless, but can destroy the remaining stored abilities. You may also choose to evacuate with the people you saved instead of gambling their lives on another check.

The interface shows the exact difficulty and consequences before you act. This is the final commitment.

actions.label: Use the isolated rooftop relay to make the manual cutoff safer

success.text: With the city network isolated, the surge has nowhere to go. You and Imani stop the Engine.

failure.text: The local core still overloads. Imani triggers the destructive cutoff, saving the city at the cost of stored abilities.

actions.label: Use the lens bypass for a controlled restoration

success.text: You and Imani divide the shutdown sequence. The fragments flow back into the city.

failure.text: The recovery fails halfway. You abandon the return process and trigger the hard cutoff. The city is saved, but some stolen abilities are lost.

actions.label: Broadcast Vey’s signed orders before cutting the Engine

success.text: You speak directly to the city while Imani holds the connection. Vey’s signature fills every screen.

failure.text: Vey jams the broadcast. You pull the emergency cutoff instead; the evidence survives in your hands even though the city did not see it tonight.

actions.label: Destroy the core and accept the loss of stored abilities

success.text: The core cracks. The white beam dies. You pull Imani away from the collapse.

failure.text: The core survives your first blow. Imani shoves you through the emergency door and holds the lever herself. Her sacrifice stops the Engine.

actions.label: Coordinate a manual shutdown with Imani

success.text: You read the surge rhythm while Imani moves the switches. The Engine stops without a final blast.

failure.text: The final surge comes early. The Engine sends its first wave before the power dies.

actions.label: Lead the rescued ward outside and leave the final cutoff to Imani

success.text: You choose the lives already in your hands. Imani tells you to go, then locks the door behind you.

ending_restore.title: A city that can choose again
ending_restore.text:
The sky fills with returning fragments of light. The baker's floating hands appear above her cold ovens. The courier, bruised but alive, lifts from the clinic cot. The captives' names stop becoming numbers.

Imani survives beside you, laughing from exhaustion rather than triumph. Vey is arrested in the dark control room. Whether you recovered proof or rescued the ward changes what your log can testify to, but the clean bypass has preserved the stolen powers.

Meridian will still need laws, repairs, and arguments. Tonight, its people get to have those arguments as themselves.

VICTORY — The Engine is stopped and its stored abilities are returned. Your journal retains the people and evidence you saved on the way.

ending_exposed.title: The city saw the signature
ending_exposed.text:
Vey's own orders appear on every public screen. The guards outside lower their weapons. Families learn where the missing people were taken. Nobody can explain this away as a machine malfunction.

Imani cuts the Engine while the crowd is still reading. The tower goes dark. Some stolen abilities remain locked in dead hardware, but the people are no longer being overwritten.

You leave with an engineer at your side and a city full of witnesses. Stopping the attack mattered. Making its author answer for it mattered too.

VICTORY — The overwrite is stopped and Vey is publicly exposed. Returning every stored ability remains unfinished work.

ending_costly.title: The light that does not return
ending_costly.text:
The Engine breaks before its final transmission. Imani escapes with you. The city remains itself, but some people search their hands for abilities that no longer answer.

No one calls that cost imaginary. You chose a destructive cutoff because it was available when a gentler solution was not. The people you rescued are still people, powered or not.

At dawn, volunteers arrive with tools instead of miracles. They begin taking the tower apart.

VICTORY AT A COST — The city is saved; some stolen abilities are permanently lost.

ending_evidence.title: A case that survives the night
ending_evidence.text:
The public broadcast fails, but Vey cannot erase the paper in your coat. Imani stops the Engine with a hard cutoff. The two of you escape into a plaza that does not yet know what happened above it.

Tomorrow will involve testimony, recovered records, and arguments. Tonight, the people still have their memories. Orin, if you freed him, can remember every line even if the paper burns.

VICTORY — The city is saved and the evidence survives, but public accountability is not yet secured.

ending_manual.title: Ordinary hands on extraordinary switches
ending_manual.text:
You and Imani stop the Engine by reading its rhythm and moving physical switches. No hidden chosen-one requirement appears. The machine obeys its own design, and its final command never reaches the city.

The stored abilities remain in the dark lens, recoverable only through careful work later. Vey loses control of the tower; the people outside will decide what happens to its architect.

VICTORY — The overwrite is prevented by a manual shutdown. Recovery remains possible, not automatic.

ending_sacrifice.title: Someone stayed at the lever
ending_sacrifice.text:
Imani stops the Engine after your attempt fails, but the collapsing control room leaves no path back to her. You reach the street carrying her last instruction: make the city see what happened.

The overwrite is prevented. That fact does not make her absence small. The log records what you saved and what your choices cost, without rewriting this into a clean triumph.

COSTLY ENDING — Meridian survives. Imani does not.

ending_partial.title: The first wave
ending_partial.text:
The Engine dies, but its first wave has already crossed one district. Survivors there remember their names and their homes, but not why they resisted the tower. Elsewhere, people are untouched.

Imani lives. Together, you begin the work of finding those altered by the pulse. Vey has been stopped, not undone.

PARTIAL FAILURE — The city-wide attack is prevented, but one district is harmed. Your surviving evidence and rescued witnesses matter now.

ending_evacuation.title: Twelve people, not an abstraction
ending_evacuation.text:
You lead the ward down through smoke. One patient carries another. Eda calls their names until every answer is accounted for. Imani's final transmission is a simple instruction: keep going.

The Engine dies behind you. Imani does not emerge. You saved the people in front of you, but left the final risk to someone else.

COSTLY ENDING — The rescued ward survives and the city is spared, at the cost of Imani's life.

defeat_escape.title: The warning outside the walls
defeat_escape.text:
You escape the tower, alive but unable to stop the transmission. A white wave crosses Meridian. People in the plaza lower their hands and forget what they were protesting.

Whatever evidence or survivors you saved remain real. They may seed another resistance, but that is not the adventure you won tonight. Vey still holds the city.

DEFEAT — You survived. The Concordance Engine completed its first city-wide overwrite. Export the log if you want to keep this outcome, or start a new run with a different route.

defeat_captured.title: An empty line on a form
defeat_captured.text:
The restraint field locks you in place. Vey completes the command and orders a new diagnostic chair prepared. Imani is pulled from the lever.

Your resistance becomes an entry in a report that no one outside the tower is allowed to read. The story ends here for this run; a failed plan has not secretly become success.

DEFEAT — You are captured and the city is overwritten.

deadlineText: You spent too many actions before the final cutoff. The Concordance Engine completes its city-wide overwrite. This run ends in defeat.
